title: Redstrike Coverage Ledger
description: Per-engagement record of which vulnerability categories were attempted, skipped (with a reason), or not applicable (phase not in scope). Produced deterministically by scripts/coverage.py --plan from routing-map.json + recon signals, then updated by the orchestrator as each category runs. Makes 'not attempted' a first-class, visible state so a silent gap cannot hide behind a clean report.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the plan/last update.

map_version.description: version of routing-map.json this ledger was planned from.

active_phases.description: phases in scope for this engagement (web always; others when requested or auto-activated by a signal).

signals_used.description: recon signals that were available at plan time; empty = signals unavailable (categories default to attempt for recall).

skills.description: feeder + executor agents this category entails.

status.description: pending=routed, not yet run (a gap if still pending at close); attempted=run; skipped=not routed (needs reason); n/a=phase not in scope; blocked=ran but demonstration blocked by environment; pipeline=capability stage over findings.

reason.description: why this status — REQUIRED for skipped/n/a/blocked; a stated trigger or baseline note for attempted/pending.

triggers_matched.description: recon signals that routed this category.

findings_count.description: accepted findings this category produced (filled after the run).

decided_by.description: deterministic-map for a planned route/skip; operator/model when a human or the agent overrode it (with reason).
